attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `nuo` operon.** Columns 0 to 10 are spine, 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and 0% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 99 to 100% of these genes, and no column hesitates more than 0.07 bits. [[NADH-quinone oxidoreduction]] runs from `nuoC` to `nuoN`.

**The first fork is at `yfbM`**, column 11, where 26% of calls are in a region of plasticity and hesitation peaks at 1.21 bits. The model names only 76 to 78% there. Then a spine returns, columns 13 to 33, 92 to 94% of chromosomes, from `rbn` through the `men` and `arn` genes to `yfaY`, named in 83 to 99% of calls.

**A variable stretch follows**, columns 34 to 37, in a region of plasticity in 34 to 52% of calls, carrying `yfaX` to `yfaU`. The model still names 94 to 96%. Then columns 38 to 47 are spine again, `rpnE` to `nrdA`, named in 92 to 98%, with `glpQ` the fewest named at 92%.

**The most plastic stretch is columns 57 to 62**, variable, in a region of plasticity in 57 to 76% of calls, where the `ato` genes are carried by 76 to 81% of chromosomes. The model names 93 to 95% there. The window ends at column 79, `napC`, a fork carried by 36% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.59 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 97%. Overall it names 96% of genes at 0.27 bits.

label: nuoC
facts:
WINDOW: the nuoC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor nuoC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,428 to 1,507 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying nuoC once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.27 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,113 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 8,762 calls, named 85%, 0.66 bits; cloud 165 calls, named 13%, 3.87 bits. Outside an RGP 35,779 calls, named 97%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 7,261 calls, named 88%, 0.59 bits. Columns: 54 spine, 4 fork, 22 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.59 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 97%); 7,261 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 11 (yfbM) 1.21 bits, RGP 26%; column 12 (yfbL) 1.13 bits, RGP 26%; column 13 (rbn) 0.73 bits, RGP 26%. The 8 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 94%, 0.35 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 96%, 0.27 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 57-62 (variable), RGP 57-76%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: nuoC, nuoE, nuoF, nuoG, nuoH, nuoI, nuoJ "NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit…", nuoK, nuoL, nuoM, nuoN. named 99-100% (mean 99.8%), fewest named at column 4 (nuoH), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.07 bits (column 2 (nuoF)).
2. columns 11-12 (2 columns) fork: RGP 26%. named 76-78% (mean 77%), fewest named at column 12, named 76%; most hesitant at column 11, 1.21 bits.
   11: yfbM P 89% "DUF1877 family protein"; also yfbP S 27%
   12: yfbL S 53% "M28 family metallopeptidase"; also yfbO S 27%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 19%
3. columns 13-33 (21 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 0-26%. Genes: rbn, elaA, elaB "stress response protein ElaB", menF, menD, menH "alpha/beta fold hydrolase", menB, menC, menE, pmrD, arnF, arnE, arnT, arnD, arnA, arnC, arnB "aminotransferase class I/II-fold py…", ais, nudI, yfaZ "YfaZ family outer membrane protein", yfaY "nicotinamide mononucleotide deamida…". named 83-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 13 (rbn), named 83%, 0.73 bits.
4. columns 34-37 (4 columns) variable: RGP 34-52%. named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 36, named 94%; most hesitant at column 34, 0.37 bits.
   34: yfaX S 78% "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…"
   35: rhmD S 80%
   36: yfaV S 85% "MFS transporter"
   37: yfaU S 89% "2-keto-3-deoxy-L-rhamnonate aldolase"
5. columns 38-47 (10 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 3-31%. Genes: rpnE, glpC "anaerobic glycerol-3-phosphate dehy…", glpB, glpA, glpT, glpQ, inaA, yfaE "ferredoxin-like diferric-tyrosyl ra…", nrdB, nrdA "class 1a ribonucleoside-diphosphate…". named 92-98% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 43 (glpQ), named 92%; most hesitant at column 44 (inaA), 0.54 bits.
6. columns 48-49 (2 columns) variable: RGP 7%. named 86-91% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 49, named 86%, 0.60 bits.
   48: yfcQ S 2% "fimbrial protein"
   49: yfaL S 83% "AIDA-I family autotransporter adhes…"
7. columns 50-51 (2 columns) spine: share 94%, all P, RGP 7-10%. Genes: ubiG, gyrA. named 92%; most hesitant at column 51 (gyrA), 0.50 bits.
8. columns 52-55 (4 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 16-42%. named 91-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 52, named 91%, 0.53 bits.
   52 variable: yfaA P 89% "DUF2138 domain-containing protein"
   53 fork: yfaT P 90% "DUF1175 domain-containing protein"; also ypaB S 84%
   54 variable: yfaS S 82%
   55 variable: yfaQ S 89% "YfaQ family protein"
9. column 56 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 49%. Genes: yfaP "YfaP family protein". named 96%; 0.34 bits.
10. columns 57-62 (6 columns) variable: RGP 57-76%. named 93-95% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 61, named 93%; most hesitant at column 57, 0.42 bits.
   columns 57-62, share 76-81%, all S: atoB 78%, atoE 80%, atoA "acetate CoA-transferase subunit beta" 80%, atoD 81%, atoC 78%, atoS 76%
11. column 63 spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 50%. Genes: rcsB. named 97%; 0.24 bits.
12. column 64 variable: RGP 44%. named 94%; 0.27 bits.
   64: emrY P 4%
13. columns 65-72 (8 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all P, RGP 4-38%. Genes: ompC, apbE, ada, alkB, yojI "microcin J25 efflux ABC transporter…", mqo, eco, yojO "protein YojO". named 94-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 65 (ompC), named 94%; most hesitant at column 71 (eco), 0.35 bits.
14. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-3%. named 96-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 73, named 96%, 0.30 bits.
   columns 73-78 variable, share 46-86%, all P: napF 86%, napD 78%, napA 69%, napG 59%, napH 52%, napB "nitrate reductase cytochrome c-type…" 46%
   79 fork: napC P 36%; also ccmA P 23%, ccmB P 16%, ccmC P 11%
